correctness.rationale: The corona Laplacian has core block (m+1)I-J and pendant offdiagonal -I. Schur elimination of (L+tI) gives the two scalar core resolvent modes and the determinant lemma reduces any two-leader pinned inverse trace to four orbit expressions CC, LL, CO, CX. Direct subtractions give J_CC-J_CO<0, J_CC-J_LL<0 for all m>=3,k>0 and J_CC-J_CX=[2k²+m(6-m)k-m²(m-2)]/((k+m)(k(m+2)+2m)); unique positive quadratic root kappa_m=(m/4)(m-6+sqrt(m²-4m+20)) yields CC below, CX above, both at equality. Pair counts follow orbit sizes. Independent rational Gauss-Jordan inversion of every pair on m=3,4,5 at gains 1/3,5,24 gave 264 exact cases including m=5,k=5 tie, agreeing with the claim; universal proof is the analytic orbit and rational inequalities.
